reaction_network_config.description: Dictionary for configuring the reaction network.

trajectories_dir.description: Directory for saving/loading the trajectory files.

results_dir.description: Directory for saving the results files.

reaction_network.description: Class name of the reaction network example to use.

reaction_network_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the reaction network to use in file names and logging.

n_species.description: Number of species in the reaction network. Not used by most reaction networks.

parameter_dict.description: Dictionary of reaction network parameters and their values.

out_species_labels.description: List of species labels to be used by the output function.

items.description: Label of the species to be used by the output function.

output_function.description: Name of the output function to use.

output_function_arguments.description: Arguments used by the available output functions.

monomial_orders.description: Powers to use in ascending order when using the monomials output function, e.g., [1] for the first moment or [1, 2] for first and second moment. Roots can be specified as well.

items.description: Power used by the monomials output function.

exact_values_computable.description: Boolean flag indicating if an exact solution for the reaction network is available.

sel_param_labels.description: List of potential reaction network parameters of interest. Serves as a placeholder for potential downstream analysis.

items.description: Name of the given parameter of interest.

t_stop.description: Final time of the training trajectories simulation.

n_time_samples.description: Number of time samples (grid points) used for the training trajectories.

init_type.description: How the initial state of the reaction network is set. Only used during training. Can be either 'deter' for deterministic (usually a predefined zero state) or 'uniform' for uniform sampling between lower and upper bounds.

lower_bound.description: Lower bound used for uniform sampling of the initial state of the reaction network. Can be a single integer or a list of integers with a length of n_species.

items.description: Lower bound of the initial state of the reaction network for the given species.

upper_bound.description: Upper bound used for uniform sampling of the initial state of the reaction network. Can be a single integer or a list of integers with a length of n_species.

items.description: Upper bound of the initial state of the reaction network for the given species.

neural_network_config.description: Dictionary for all settings related to the neural network and model training.

training_seed.description: Random seed used by numpy during training.

torch_seed.description: Random seed used by torch during training.

use_previous_training_weights.description: Boolean setting if the model should be initialized with weights from a previous run and starting training from there. Uses the trained_model_timestamp or trained_model_path for reading the model weights.

trained_model_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the trained model to be used for loading the model weights.

trained_model_path.description: Optional path to a trained model file to load the model weights from. If provided, this path overrides the trained_model_timestamp setting.

training_history_path.description: Optional path to a training history file to load the training history from. If provided, this path overrides the default training history path derived from the trained_model_timestamp.

model_training_needed.description: Boolean flag indicating if the model should be trained. Otherwise, the model is loaded using the trained_model_timestamp or a combination of trained_model_path and training_history_path.

as_relationship.description: Which almost sure relationship to use for learning V.

single_pred_term.description: If set to true, only the full interval is used for computing the neural network prediction. Otherwise, each subinterval is used as well.

exact_time_derivative.description: If set to true, the exact time derivative using torch.nn.functional.jacobian is computed for the PINN loss. Otherwise, the difference quotient is used.

square_pinn_once.description: If set to true, the PINN loss is squared once before computing the final loss. Otherwise, each term is squared individually.

loss_function.description: Loss function to use for training. Only considered with the identity relationship.

loss_component_weights.description: Weights/multipliers of the loss components. Only considered with the identity relationship and if there are multiple loss components, such as in id_pinn_loss.

items.description: Weight of the given loss component.

adaptive_weights.description: If set to true, the loss component weights are adapted during training.

update_rate.description: Update rate for the adaptive weights. Only considered if adaptive_weights is set to true.

normalization.description: Normalization approach used for the expectation delta.

inner_loss.description: Inner loss function (or normalization approach) which changes how the delta is computed. If a list is provided, the inner_loss_change_index is used to switch between the two inner losses after a certain number of training steps.

inner_loss_change_index.description: Index of the training step after which the inner loss is changed. Only considered if inner_loss is a list.

use_early_stopping.description: Boolean flag indicating if early stopping of the training should be used.

use_analysis_subnet_for_early_stopping.description: Boolean flag indicating if the analysis subnet should be used for computing the early stopping criterion.

early_stopping_batch_size.description: Batch size used for early stopping evaluation.

early_stopping_count.description: Number of consecutive evaluations below threshold needed to trigger early stopping.

early_stopping_fraction.description: Fraction of the validation set that needs to be below the threshold for the count of successful evaluations to increase.

use_exact_eigenfunctions.description: If set to true, the exact eigenfunctions are used for the spectral architectures and only the decay modes are learned. This only works for specific reaction network examples.

only_train_func_dependence.description: If set to true, only the function coordinates are retrained. This only works with the spectral architectures.

forward_subnets.description: Whether to use shared or distinct forward subnets for computing V and dV.

analysis_subnets.description: Whether to use shared or distinct subnets during analysis.

subnet_architecture.description: Subnetwork architecture to use for computing V (and potentially dV).

n_temporal_features.description: Number of temporal features, only used by the 'features' architecture.

n_spectral_terms.description: Number of spectral terms, only used by the spectral architectures.

stationary_mean_initialization.description: How to initialize the stationary mean of the spectral architectures. If 'exact' is set and not available, it will fall back to the ergodic 'estimate'.

erg_t_min.description: Minimum time used for estimating the stationary mean of the spectral architectures.

erg_t_max.description: Maximum time used for estimating the stationary mean of the spectral architectures.

erg_n_trajectories.description: Number of trajectories used for estimating the stationary mean of the spectral architectures. Relevant for providing confidence intervals of the estimate.

decay_modes_initialization.description: How to initialize the decay modes of the spectral architectures. Uses the provided decay_modes_real and decay_modes_imag if set to [fixed, trainable].

decay_modes_real.description: Real part of the decay modes of the spectral architectures. Only used if decay_modes_initialization is set to [fixed, trainable]. Provide your real decay modes with length n_spectral_terms here.

items.description: Real part of the decay mode of the given spectral term.

decay_modes_imag.description: Imaginary part of the decay modes of the spectral architectures. Only used if decay_modes_initialization is set to [fixed, trainable]. Provide your imaginary decay modes with length n_spectral_terms here.

items.description: Imaginary part of the decay mode of the given spectral term.

pairing_mode.description: Sets if decay modes are treated as conjugate pairs when using the 'spectral_complex' architecture.

train_samples_needed.description: Boolean flag indicating if training samples are needed. If set to false, the data is read from the trajectories_dir.

valid_samples_needed.description: Boolean flag indicating if validation samples are needed. If set to false, the data is read from the trajectories_dir.

use_ssa_samples.description: Boolean flag indicating if SSA samples should be used for training and validation. If set to false, constant trajectories are used.

resample_during_training.description: Boolean flag to set resampling strategies for the constant trajectories.

resampling_frequency.description: Every resampling_frequency steps, new trajectory data is created. The setting is used for the constant trajectories.

train_size.description: Size of the training data set (number of trajectories).

valid_size.description: Size of the validation data set (number of trajectories).

save_train_data.description: Boolean flag indicating if the training data should be saved to disc.

save_valid_data.description: Boolean flag indicating if the validation data should be saved to disc.

use_is_resampling.description: Generate new DeepIS training and validation data after a given step to use for further optimization.

is_resampling_start.description: Start step of the DeepIS resampling. This is where the loss function is changed and new training and validation data is generated for the first time.

is_resampling_frequency.description: Every is_resampling_frequency steps, new DeepIS trajectory data is created using the updated neural network.

is_resampling_train_size.description: Number of training samples to use for the resampling.

is_resampling_valid_size.description: Number of validation samples to use for the resampling.

lr_scheduler.description: Type of learning rate scheduler to use.

n_steps.description: Maximum number of training steps to take (can be fewer if early stopping is used). This corresponds to the total number of backward passes (not forward passes).

use_mini_batches.description: Boolean flag indicating if mini-batches should be used for training.

use_full_length_trajectories.description: Boolean flag indicating if full length trajectories should be used (instead of randomly varying the time window size and position). Only relevant if use_mini_batches is set to true.

mini_batch_size.description: Size of mini-batches used for training. The mini-batch size needs to be provided as n_trajectories * n_time_samples.

backward_frequency.description: Frequency of backward passes during training. Means that only one backward pass is done for every backward_frequency forward passes.

n_nodes_per_layer.description: Number of nodes per layer in the subnet.

n_hidden_layers.description: Number of hidden layers in the subnet.

oneOf.description: Load using explicit model and history paths.

validation_config.description: Dictionary for configuring simulation and validation settings.

run_test_state_analysis.description: Boolean flag indicating if the test state analysis should be run.

t_stop.description: Final time of the validation simulation.

n_time_samples.description: Number of time samples used for validation.

test_states.description: List of custom test states for validation.

n_random_states.description: Number of random states to use for validation (in addition to any custom test states).

tolerance_band.description: Tolerance band for the validation of the model. This can be used instead of the confidence interval and sets a lower/upper boundary according to the set percentage.

n_trajectories.description: Number of trajectories to use for validation.

compute_cv_estimate.description: Boolean flag indicating if the DeepCV estimate should be computed (to potentially save time).

ssa_with_cv_fraction.description: Fraction of trajectories to use for the 'SSA with DeepCV' analysis.

compute_is_estimate.description: Boolean flag indicating if the DeepIS estimate should be computed (because it is computationally expensive).

ssa_with_is_fraction.description: Fraction of trajectories to use for the 'SSA with DeepIS' analysis.

n_is_samples.description: Number of time samples to use for the DeepIS estimate.

is_simulation_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the DeepIS estimate. As soon as one trajectory exceeds the timeout, the whole simulation type is skipped. If set to null, no timeout is used.

compute_deep_var_estimates.description: Boolean flag indicating if the DeepPVA/DeepIPA variance estimates should be computed (to potentially save time).

deep_pva_var_fraction.description: Fraction of trajectories to use for DeepPVA.

deep_ipa_var_fraction.description: Fraction of trajectories to use for DeepIPA.

em_validation_needed.description: Boolean flag indicating if EM (ergodic mean) validation is needed.

erg_t_min.description: Minimum time used for ergodic mean validation.

erg_t_max.description: Maximum time used for ergodic mean validation.

erg_n_trajectories.description: Number of trajectories used for ergodic mean validation.

conv_t_stop.description: Final time for the convergence simulation.

conv_n_time_samples.description: Number of time samples to use for the convergence simulation (should match the grid spacing for the rest of the analysis, just compute it in your head).

conv_n_repeats.description: Number of repeats for the convergence simulation (to get a better estimate of the variance). Goes into effect if it is larger than 1.

conv_test_states.description: List of test states for the convergence simulation. This needs to be a subset of the usual test_states, otherwise they are not analyzed.

items.description: Test state for the convergence simulation.

conv_ref_n_trajectories.description: Number of trajectories to use as a reference for the convergence analysis. This is solely used as a ground truth and usually uses a lot of trajectories.

conv_ref_trajectory_type.description: Type of the reference trajectories for the convergence analysis.

conv_n_trajectories.description: Number of trajectories to use for the convergence analysis. The 'SSA with DeepCV' estimate is based on this.

conv_ssa_with_cv_fraction.description: Fraction of trajectories to use for the convergence 'SSA with DeepCV' analysis.

conv_use_exact_cv.description: Use the exact 'SSA with DeepCV' for the convergence analysis.

conv_ssa_with_is_fraction.description: Fraction of trajectories to use for the convergence 'SSA with DeepIS' analysis.

share_panel_y_axes.description: Boolean flag indicating if the y-axes of the panels should be shared (same scaling in each row).

use_theta_in_labels.description: Boolean flag indicating if theta should be shown in the plots.

n_plotted_trajectories.description: Number of individual trajectories to plot for the validation plots.

rescale_trajectory_plots.description: Boolean flag indicating if the trajectory plots should be rescaled to zoom into a specific region on the time axis.

trajectory_plot_minimum.description: Minimum time for the trajectory plots, only relevant if rescale_trajectory_plots is set to true.

trajectory_plot_maximum.description: Maximum time for the trajectory plots, only relevant if rescale_trajectory_plots is set to true.

plot_estimate_convergence.description: Boolean flag indicating if the estimate convergence should be plotted.

convergence_plot_samples.description: Number of samples to plot in the convergence plot (spaced logarithmically).

convergence_plot_maximum.description: Maximum number of samples plotted in the convergence plot (must be lower than the number of samples simulated for all plotted methods).
